citations.assessment: The reciprocal source notice names Sama and both Bavli transmitters. The Bavli has Ravina receiving from Sama an objection by the father of Avuvram’s son, or alternatively by the brother of Avuvram’s son. Heilprin’s shorthand must remain distinguishable from both witnesses.
Here Rav Simai bar Ḥilkai questions Ravina. Preserve Heilprin’s two written forms.

holds.reason: Retain Heilprin’s compressed attribution, alongside the two Bavli alternatives, rather than identifying the attributed voice.
